sf.label: SF Lite
sf.method: Local anchor receipts only. No whole-game SF scan.

notes.text: The white rook on a7 can answer ...Rh5 with Ra6!, attacking the black queen on g6. 32.Rad7 abandons that resource; ...Rh5 attacks White’s queen and ...Rg5 increases the pressure. Local Lite at depth 21 shows almost no gap, but a constrained same-root d30 search finds about 4.70 pawns of score difference between 32.Kh1 and 32.Rad7.
